name: Voloridge Investment Management
page_total_how: Playwright render of https://www.voloridge.com/join-our-team (2026-10-20) lists 11 openings (4 internship, 6 career, 1 programme), each linking /jobs/voloridgeinvestmentmanagement/<greenhouse id>; the ids equal the API's
notes: The bookmarked /careers/ is a 404; the nav uses /join-our-team (Drupal block fed from the Greenhouse API). Besides the 3 '… Intern 2027' roles (Jupiter, FL) there are 'Quantitative Research Fellowship 2027' and 'Ascend Program 2027' student programmes that the intern regex does not catch. 'VOLO Health' (volohealth.com/careers) is a separate affiliate, not tracked.
